title: Be authorised to supply medicines and poisons
what: Supply declared substances (medicines and poisons) to others, including by wholesale, only when authorised (such as under a wholesale licence).

laws.title: Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2008 (ACT)

sources.title: Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2008 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 26(1) (current republication (R29, from 26 November 2025; Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2008 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person supplies a declared substance to someone else; and (b) the person is not authorised to supply the substance to the other person

sources.title: Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2008 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 6, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current republication (R29, from 26 November 2025; Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2008 | Acts)
sources.quote: the chief health officer may issue a licence to a person to deal with a regulated substance or regulated therapeutic good even if the licence is not prescribed by regulation for subsection (2).
